response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS daily_rate FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(daily_rate) AS avg_daily FROM per_rating), above AS (SELECT p.daily_rate FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.daily_rate > o.avg_daily) SELECT AVG(a.daily_rate) AS avg_daily_rate_above, AVG(a.daily_rate - o.avg_daily) AS avg_gap_above_overall FROM above a CROSS JOIN overall o;
